item.title: Orchard After Dark
item.description:
When: Friday, August 7, 2026 · 8pm – 9:30pm

Where: Blue Bee Cider, 4811 Bethlehem Road, Richmond, VA 23230

Cost: $21

An immersive, whimsical burlesque showcase set in an enchanted orchard at Blue Bee Cider, blending fantasy, tease, and cider. 18+ event, doors at 7:30 PM.

item.title: RadQueer presents Camp Genderf*ck
item.description:
When: Saturday, August 15, 2026 · 7pm – 10:30pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $10-$25 sliding scale

RadQueer Productions presents a burlesque celebration of camp and genderf*ck, hosted by Mx. Casey Camp and featuring Richmond's LGBTQ+ burlesque performers. Doors at 7pm, show at 8pm; 18+ only.

item.title: Studio 8: A Disco Burlesque Experience
item.description:
When: Friday, August 21, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Presented by Onyx & 8th, a one-night disco-themed burlesque and variety revue blending classic burlesque, showgirl glamour, and immersive nightlife performance. Doors at 8pm, show at 9pm; 18+ only.
